themes_detail.label: Dead trees citywide spike
themes_detail.summary: Dead and dying tree complaints in CD 107 surged to 8 complaints last week—a 1500% spike versus the 0.5-complaint weekly baseline—suggesting either a recent die-off event, pest infestation, or drought stress affecting Upper West Side street trees this week.
evidence: 8 dead/dying tree complaints last week vs. 0.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (1500% spike, z-score: 10.61)
Spike is statistically severe and emerged THIS WEEK
Parks and Recreation is listed as chronic budget priority, suggesting ongoing maintenance gaps
reporting_angles: Interview Parks Dept to determine if this reflects disease, extreme weather, or deferred maintenance
Canvass affected blocks to identify pattern—is it one neighborhood pocket or citywide?

themes_detail.label: Industrial waste dumping surge
themes_detail.summary: Industrial waste complaints jumped to 3 last week—a 2300% spike over the 0.1 weekly baseline—indicating possible illegal dumping or commercial enforcement failures on the Upper West Side this week.
evidence: 3 industrial waste complaints last week vs. 0.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (2300% spike, z-score: 8.69)
Spike is statistically severe and emerged THIS WEEK
No prior pattern in complaint history suggests new problem rather than seasonal trend
reporting_angles: Identify the specific blocks and businesses involved; determine if complaints are from same location
Contact DSNY and DEP to understand enforcement response and whether illegal dumping network is operating in district

themes_detail.label: Curb and street deterioration
themes_detail.summary: Curb condition complaints hit 17 last week—a 467% spike over the 3.0 weekly baseline—suggesting accelerated street surface degradation on the Upper West Side this week, potentially from recent heavy weather or deferred repairs.
evidence: 17 curb condition complaints last week vs. 3.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (467% spike, z-score: 14.0)
Spike is statistically severe and emerged THIS WEEK
Street condition remains #5 overall complaint type (996 complaints over 90 days), indicating chronic underinvestment
reporting_angles: Map complaint locations to identify geographic hotspot; determine if weather event triggered this spike
Interview DDOT about current street repair backlog and timeline for addressing curb deterioration

themes_detail.label: Asbestos hazard spike
themes_detail.summary: Asbestos complaints jumped to 8 last week—a 700% spike versus the 1.0 weekly baseline—raising urgent public health concerns about building violations or renovation disturbances on the Upper West Side this week.
evidence: 8 asbestos complaints last week vs. 1.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (700% spike, z-score: 7.0)
Spike is statistically severe and emerged THIS WEEK
1159 DOB permit filings in last 90 days (1070 alterations) suggests active construction may be disturbing asbestos-containing materials in older buildings
reporting_angles: Cross-reference asbestos complaints with DOB alteration permits to identify which buildings/projects may have violated asbestos handling protocols
Interview DOHMH and NYC Department of Environmental Protection about investigation status and health risks to nearby residents

themes_detail.label: Park noise disturbances
themes_detail.summary: Park noise complaints spiked to 11 last week—an 878% increase over the 1.1 weekly baseline—suggesting recent events, construction, or enforcement lapses in Upper West Side parks this week.
evidence: 11 park noise complaints last week vs. 1.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (878% spike, z-score: 7.24)
Spike is statistically severe and emerged THIS WEEK
Parks budget request from CB suggests chronic resource constraints on maintenance and enforcement
reporting_angles: Determine which parks generated complaints; investigate if specific events or construction projects are driving noise
Contact Parks Dept about permit approvals and noise enforcement capacity in district
